name: orchestrator
description: Event-driven orchestration engine: subscribes to platform EventBridge events and dispatches actions (email, and later SMS/voice/agentic) based on workflow definitions stored in the Core API. Durable state lives in Core (ADR-0002); this plugin runs its own Lambda and reaches Core over the IAM-authenticated internal API (ADR-0009).
author: Biffo Team

event_subscriptions.description: Thin-wedge trigger: on a demo request, dispatch the email action of any enabled workflow definition matching (biffo.core, demo.requested). Subscriptions are wired into the plugin's own Lambda via the SDK EventSubscriber (see src/orchestrator/main.py) and the plugin's EventBridge rule (terraform/), not synthesized by the Core API.
